alternatives.name: Runtime structural compatibility checking
alternatives.description: Make isinstance() checks perform full structural comparison for Protocol types at runtime.
alternatives.reason_rejected: Deep structural comparison on every isinstance call would be extremely expensive. The cost is proportional to the complexity of the protocol.

alternatives.name: Use ABCs instead of Protocols
alternatives.description: Continue using Abstract Base Classes for structural subtyping via __subclasshook__.
alternatives.reason_rejected: ABCs require explicit registration or inheritance. Protocols capture duck typing patterns that ABCs cannot express without modifying the checked class.

alternatives.name: Implicit protocol inference
alternatives.description: Let type checkers automatically infer protocols from usage patterns without explicit Protocol definitions.
alternatives.reason_rejected: Implicit protocols make it impossible to distinguish intentional structural contracts from coincidental method overlap. Explicit is better than implicit.

objections.text: Protocols add another way to define interfaces alongside ABCs, increasing the conceptual surface of the type system.
